job.title: HR Manager

company.name: Talenta Partners Group
company.description: Specializes in recruitment through direct search and HR consultants. Supports clients in acquiring top-level talent and matching candidates to professional projects.

job.summary: Recruiting an HR Manager for one of our client companies.
responsibilities: Ensure administrative organization of employees across the full employee lifecycle (hiring, contracts, amendments, departures, etc.)
Ensure administrative files comply with legal/regulatory requirements
Monitor workforce KPIs and productivity indicators
Master payroll management processes, coordinating with relevant stakeholders
Monitor time tracking, absences, leave, and overtime
Ensure the reliability of workforce and payroll data
Manage sourcing, screening, and interview coordination for open roles
Contribute to onboarding of new employees
Identify training needs in coordination with department managers
Develop the training plan and follow up on its execution
Ensure monitoring and evaluation of training procedures

requirements.education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources / Management
requirements.experience_type: Proven experience in a general (generalist) HR role

core_skill_areas: workforce & payroll data reliability / KPI reporting
